about: What users said in the calls behind the dispatch plan (docs/VOICE_DISPATCH_PLAN_20261112.md §3), reworded and without names. Each utterance carries the route it must get: chat (answer on the phone), lookup (answer from a quick read), dispatch (hand to the assistant: new work, a change, a push to proceed, a new conversation), card (a choice on a card the call showed). The same lines feed the route benchmark (scripts/voice_route_bench.py) and the live replay (tests/manual/voice_replay.py --utterances).
